choices.why: This light oak drop-leaf table seats four with simple Nordic lines, and the folding leaves suit the compact space beside the kitchenette.
The black spindle-back chairs are a classic Nordic shape, and at 50 cm wide four of them fit comfortably around the table.
This matte light grey bell pendant is simple and Scandinavian, and its modest size suits a small table.
The low white sideboard with light wood fronts blends into the white wall and echoes the light wood of the kitchen and table.

answer.why: Light oak, white and black make a calm, simple Nordic palette that matches the white walls, the pale floor and the light wood kitchenette, and the black chairs add contrast without weighing down the small space.
